fit_reason: Whole boat (Yamaha jet boat with trailer) listed by a private seller on Facebook Marketplace.
findings: Blue hull gelcoat on the port side looks glossy with no visible chalkiness
Light water spotting and faint stains on the tan mat on the swim platform and rear cockpit inserts
Some light marks on the white vinyl of the bow seating
Cockpit and helm look tidy and uncluttered
Hull below the cover is mostly hidden in the trailer photos
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Yamaha Limited S and it looks well kept. We noticed some light water spots on the tan mats at the swim platform and a few marks on the white vinyl up front. We do mobile pre-sale details for boats, a cleanup of the mats and vinyl plus a wash and wax, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
